name: shuiyinimg
_version_sync_note: 只需改 package.json 的 version。tauri:dev / tauri:build 会经 tauri.conf 钩子自动 sync；也可用 npm version patch。在 Apple Silicon 上默认 tauri:build 只打 arm64 DMG。要 Intel：`npm run tauri:build:mac-intel`（会先 rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin；需本机已装 rustup 且 Xcode CLT）。云打包：`Actions → Tauri multi-platform builds`（或推送 tag 「v…」）；Artifacts：`Gouer-mac-arm64` / `Gouer-mac-intel` / `Gouer-win-x64` / `Gouer-win-x86`。推送 `v*` tag 成功后 workflow 会向 **GitHub Releases** 挂载各平台 DMG/exe（手动 Run workflow 只产 Artifacts，不发布 Release）。

scripts.build:seo: vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs && open dist
scripts.tauri:before-build: npm run sync-version && npm run build
scripts.tauri:icon: cd src-tauri && npx tauri icon ../public/logo-app-source.png -o icons && cp icons/icon.icns ../icon.icns && cp icons/icon.ico ../icon.ico
scripts.tauri:build: npm run sync-version && node scripts/tauri-build.mjs && node scripts/open-release-tauri-mac.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:mac-intel: node scripts/ensure-rust-target.mjs x86_64-apple-darwin && npm run sync-version && node scripts/tauri-build.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/open-release-tauri-mac.mjs
